scientific_integrity: Analytical proof identifies the published map with a two-way invariant-measure factor of multiplication by 1111 mod 1; finite exact-rational checks independently test but do not establish infinite quantifiers. External independent validation not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact real-arithmetic result for positive integer gains 1,10,100,1000 on [0,4). Discontinuities use the half-open fractional-part convention. No conclusion for noninteger gains or finite precision. No cryptographic security inference. Publication priority against unindexed equivalent results is uncertain.
title: Exact periodic census and geometric memory in a four-term Rényi–remainder map
